outcome: Concentrations of 41 selected growth factors and their receptors
cohort: The study included 20 preterm infants born before 32 weeks of gestational age who developed anemia necessitating red blood cell transfusions.
finding: Autologous UCB transfusions were found to be feasible and tolerable, with a lower incidence of intraventricular haemorrhage (40% vs 86.7%) and significantly different concentrations of 22 plasma proteins in UCB recipients compared to controls.
gest_age: Born before 32 weeks of gestational age
